cohort: 21 pregnant women with non-gynecologic cancer in remission (study group) and 63 pregnant women with no history of cancer (control group) admitted to the high-risk pregnancy clinic of Zekai Tahir Burak Women's Health Training and Research Hospital with a diagnosis of pregnancy and cancer between January 2010 and January 2015
finding: No statistically significant differences were found between pregnant women with non-gynecologic cancer in remission and pregnant women with no history of cancer with regard to age, obstetric history, BMI, gestational week, smoking, and obstetric and perinatal outcomes.
